patch.summary:
Choose Shore only if your buying job matches “Appointment scheduling and local business management — affiliate partner in customer servi” rather than Tidio's shape. Choose Tidio only if your buying job matches “Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $” rather than Shore's shape. Workflow advantage: Shore leans appointment-scheduling; Tidio leans live-chat-support, ai-customer-service. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Shore is Appointment scheduling and local business management — affiliate partner in customer service.; Tidio is Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $49.17. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Shore (micro, small-business) vs Tidio (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shore-leaning appointment-scheduling vs Tidio-leaning live-chat-support, ai-customer-service.
- Researched limits: Shore — Appointment booking primary — not a helpdesk ticket queue or AI live chat; Tidio — Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers.

Limitations — Shore: Appointment booking primary — not a helpdesk ticket queue or AI live chat; POS and GoBD-compliant register limited to DACH markets; Tidio: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Not a full helpdesk/ITSM — thin ticketing vs Freshdesk.
